families.description: Flagship MOSS-TTS model for high-fidelity 31-language and code-switched speech, zero-shot voice cloning, long-form generation, and fine-grained Pinyin, phoneme, and duration control.

families.name: MOSS-TTS-Nano
families.description: Compact deployment-first MOSS-TTS model for real-time multilingual speech generation, lightweight integration, and zero-shot voice cloning.

families.name: NeuTTS
families.description: NeuTTS is an English text-to-speech family from Neuphonic. The current 2E package uses a Qwen3-style autoregressive speech-token backbone, NeuCodec waveform decoding, built-in speaker prompts, and emotion-token control.

families.name: OmniVoice
families.description: Massively multilingual zero-shot TTS model from k2-fsa for 600+ languages, supporting short-reference voice cloning, attribute-based voice design, pronunciation controls, and nonverbal tags.

packages.description: Egyptian Arabic and Arabic-English code-switching fine-tune of OmniVoice from mohammedaly22/VoiceTut-TTS (same architecture and audio tokenizer as OmniVoice). Use language=arz.
Egyptian Arabic and Arabic-English code-switching fine-tune of OmniVoice from mohammedaly22/VoiceTut-TTS (same architecture and audio tokenizer as OmniVoice). Use language=arz.

Pre-compiled RK3588 step-graph ladder (256 to 1024 token buckets) for the omnivoice RKNN generator (omnivoice.exec_plan, artifacts.main); installs beside the OmniVoice GGUF weights and is named by bare file name. Built by tools/rknn from the OmniVoice checkpoint; see docs/build/rockchip-npu.md.

Pre-compiled RK3588 front-shard ladder: all 28 backbone layers on the NPU, the CFG tail (final norm, audio heads, guidance combine) stays fp32 on the host, so guidance > 0 is usable on the NPU (omnivoice.exec_plan, artifacts.main); installs beside the OmniVoice GGUF weights and is named by bare file name. Built by tools/rknn --front-k 28 from the OmniVoice checkpoint; see docs/build/rockchip-npu.md.

families.name: Llama-OuteTTS 1.0
families.description: Llama-based open-weight TTS model for 23-language speech synthesis with one-shot voice cloning from short reference audio and automatic word-alignment support.

families.name: PersonaPlex
families.description: PersonaPlex is a Moshi-style full-duplex speech-to-speech conversational model with Mimi audio tokenization, packaged speaker/persona prompts, streaming audio input, text generation, and generated assistant speech.

families.name: Piper TTS
families.description: Native VITS inference for Piper text-to-speech voices using the shared eSpeak-ng frontend.

packages.display_name: Piper Lessac Medium NPU Decoder RKNN (RK3588)
packages.description: Pre-compiled RK3588 engine for the piper_tts RKNN decoder sidecar (piper_tts.exec_plan, artifacts.main); installs beside the GGUF weights and is named by bare file name. Built by tools/rknn from the en_US-lessac-medium streaming decoder export; see docs/build/rockchip-npu.md.

families.name: Plapre 3
families.description: Danish speech synthesis with a Llama autoregressive decoder and Kanade audio codec. Streaming emits completed text chunks, not incremental codec frames.

families.name: PocketTTS
families.description: Kyutai 100M-parameter CPU-friendly TTS package set for real-time local synthesis and small-footprint voice cloning in English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, and Spanish.

families.name: PocketTTS Small
families.description: English PocketTTS Small 18m, 7m, and 2m models, with regular and ReFL variants, for text-to-speech and voice cloning.

packages.display_name: PocketTTS Small English 18m ReFL F32 GGUF
PocketTTS Small English 7m ReFL F32 GGUF
PocketTTS Small English 2m ReFL F32 GGUF

families.name: Qwen3-TTS
families.description: Qwen3-TTS for controllable 10-language synthesis, 3-second voice cloning, CustomVoice, and VoiceDesign.

packages.display_name: Qwen3 TTS 12Hz 0.6B NPU Speech Decoder RKNN Pair (RK3588)
packages.description: Pre-compiled RK3588 engine pair (chunk 16 for the first streaming group, chunk 64 for the rest) for the qwen3_tts RKNN speech decoder (qwen3_tts.exec_plan, artifacts.main/first); installs beside the 0.6B GGUF weights and is named by bare file name. Built by tools/rknn from the Qwen3-TTS-12Hz speech tokenizer decoder; see docs/build/rockchip-npu.md.

families.name: sanoTTS Nano
families.description: Very small multilingual text-to-speech across fourteen languages. Two graphs: the nano lineage (duration student, contextual acoustic student to mel-100, noise-fed ConvNeXt-1D decoder with an iSTFT head; voices heart 2.27M and heart-nano 294k, English, 24 kHz) and the deterministic piperlite lineage (duration student, acoustic student to a 192-channel latent, optionally through a calibration adapter, then a 3-stage ConvTranspose1d decoder with dilated residual banks; voices amy, hfc and kristin for English, vi, id, cs, de, es, fr, it, pt, ro, ru, tr, ne and hi at 1.1-1.8M parameters, 22.05 kHz). Uses an external eSpeak-ng phonemizer.

families.name: Soprano
families.description: Soprano is an ultra-lightweight (~80M) English-only text-to-speech model. Syntax uses a 17-layer Qwen3-style causal LM (hidden 512, vocab 8192) that autoregressively emits per-frame 512-dimensional features; a non-iterative Vocos-style decoder (ConvNeXt backbone + single ISTFT head, n_fft 2048 / hop 512) turns those features into 32 kHz audio. No diffusion refinement is performed in the decoder.

families.name: Sopro V2 Turbo
families.description: Community Sopro V2 Turbo (samuel-vitorino/sopro-v2-turbo): a 120M zero-shot voice-cloning TTS. SentencePiece text tokenizer, style-prefix conditioned autoregressive semantic LM over FSQ tokens, rectified-flow acoustic DiT and a Vocos ISTFT vocoder at 24 kHz.

packages.description: Single-file GGUF of all four stages with the config and tokenizer embedded: f16 weights, mel front ends kept in f32.
Upstream checkpoint from samuel-vitorino/sopro-v2-turbo: config.json, tokenizer.model and the four safetensors stages. Runs directly, no conversion needed.

families.name: Supertonic 3
families.description: Supertone on-device TTS model designed for fast local speech synthesis across 31 languages, with preset voices and compact deployment for browser, mobile, and desktop applications.

families.name: VibeVoice
families.description: Microsoft long-form multi-speaker TTS model for expressive conversational audio such as podcasts, supporting up to 90 minutes of speech with as many as four speakers.

families.name: VieNeu-TTS v3 Turbo
families.description: On-device Vietnamese/English TTS (48 kHz) with instant voice cloning from 3-5 s of reference audio, by Phạm Nguyễn Ngọc Bảo (pnnbao97). Takes SEA-G2P phonemes as text input.

packages.display_name: VieNeu-TTS v3 Turbo Q8_0 GGUF (first community port, July 2026 weights)

families.name: VoxCPM1
families.description: OpenBMB VoxCPM 0.5B tokenizer-free TTS model supporting short-reference voice cloning and streaming output (16kHz).

families.name: VoxCPM2
families.description: OpenBMB tokenizer-free TTS model supporting 30 languages and 9 Chinese dialects, with 48 kHz output, natural-language voice design, controllable short-reference voice cloning, and expressive style guidance.

families.name: Voxtral 4B TTS
families.description: Mistral's Ministral-based autoregressive and flow-matching TTS model with 20 embedded preset voices.

families.name: XTTS v2
families.description: Coqui XTTS v2 cross-lingual text-to-speech with voice cloning: GPT-2 mel-code generator, perceiver conditioning resampler, HiFi-GAN decoder, and speaker encoder.

families.name: ZipVoice
families.description: Community ZipVoice / ZipVoice-Distill flow-matching TTS with a TTSZipformer backbone (U-Net downsampling stacks, compact relative position attention), duration prediction from prompt ratio, Euler solver with t-shift and classifier-free guidance, and Vocos mel-24kHz vocoder (k2-fsa/ZipVoice).

packages.description: Self-contained GGUF: flow-matching model, bundled Vocos vocoder and the embedded text-frontend sidecars (tokens, config, zh tables) in one file. Converted from k2-fsa/ZipVoice with export_zipvoice_zh_dict.py + convert_zipvoice.py.
Self-contained Q8_0 GGUF with bundled Vocos and embedded text-frontend sidecars.

families.name: ZONOS2
families.description: Zyphra ZONOS2: a 28-layer GQA/MoE TTS backbone (16 experts, EDA router) over 9 delayed 1024-entry DAC codebooks, decoded by the 44.1 kHz Descript Audio Codec, with ECAPA speaker-embedding cloning.

packages.description: F16 spine + Q8_0 experts backbone, DAC 44.1 kHz decoder, ECAPA speaker encoder (8.8 GB).

families.name: ZONOS3-Mini
families.description: Zyphra ZONOS3-Mini: a GDN/attention latent-MoE TTS backbone with Full AttnRes over 10 delayed 4096-entry codebooks and a 44.1 kHz MR-iSTFT decoder, with speaker-embedding and raw-reference cloning.

packages.description: Q4_0-expert / Q8_0-mixer backbone, keep2 MR-iSTFT decoder, MECT-B2 speaker encoder (1.2 GB).
Adds the ZAC encoder and w2v-BERT teacher for speaker_mode=reference (+5.6 GB).

families.name: MeanVC2
families.description: MeanVC2 is a lightweight streaming zero-shot voice conversion model. The current audio.cpp package covers the recommended 120ms/40ms quality path.

families.name: RVC
families.description: RVC is an offline retrieval-based voice conversion family packaged for audio.cpp with native HuBERT content features, RMVPE pitch extraction, optional IVF retrieval blending, packaged v1/v2 voices, and support for user-supplied RVC checkpoints.

families.name: Seed-VC
families.description: Zero-shot voice conversion and singing voice conversion model for transferring timbre and style from reference audio, with low-latency realtime conversion and optional lightweight fine-tuning.

families.name: Tone Color VC
families.description: Standalone voice conversion with a reference speaker recording.

families.name: Vevo2
families.description: Unified controllable framework for English and Chinese speech and singing voice generation, voice conversion, and editing, with tokenizers that disentangle content, prosody, melody, style, and timbre.
